clue.text: Still made music

definitions.meaning: first meaning: calm and collected, unruffled
second meaning: wrote a piece of music

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads like a story of carrying on playing, but the two phrases are separate senses of one word, an adjective and a past-tense verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A calm person is described as composed, and a musician who wrote a score is said to have composed it.

clue.text: Hide initially suspicion to family

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word suspicion only

parts.note: only the first letter of this word is used
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: Someone conceals from relatives that they are under suspicion at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' looks like a verb about concealment, but it is the noun for an animal's pelt.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's hide is its skin, the outer covering of the body.

clue.text: A trial might lead to the rope

indicators.note: something that might lead to another thing turns into it, so these letters are rearranged into the rope

parts.note: taken as written, these six letters are the ones rearranged

explanation.surface: A court trial could end in the hangman's noose for the accused.
explanation.walkthrough: The gallows picture hides a cowboy's rope; 'lead' also nods to a rope used as a lead.
explanation.definitionFit: A lariat is a lasso, a long noosed rope used for catching cattle and horses.

clue.text: For example, a roll could be played fast

indicators.note: these letters could be something else when shuffled into a new order

parts.note: e.g. is the abbreviation for exempli gratia, for example
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drum roll, say, might be performed at a brisk tempo.
explanation.definitionFit: Allegro is the musical direction for a lively, quick tempo, so a passage marked this way is played briskly.

clue.text: Disinfect the lot, including the upper-class fighter

indicators.note: including means the first word holds the next pieces within it

parts.note: one's lot in life is one's fate
U is the old label for upper-class usage
a MiG is a Russian fighter jet

explanation.surface: Clean out the whole place, the posh boxer included.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The lot' reads as 'everything', but it is lot meaning destiny.
explanation.definitionFit: To fumigate is to cleanse a place of pests or germs with smoke or chemical vapour.

clue.text: Joined the branch with a couple of fellows — I give particulars over

parts.note: taken as written
F is fellow, so two of them give FF
taken as written

indicators.note: over means the word is turned over and read backwards in this down clue

parts.note: to detail something is to give its particulars

explanation.surface: Someone signed up to the local branch along with two colleagues, filling in their details.
explanation.definitionFit: A body affiliated to an organisation is officially attached to it, as a local branch is linked to its parent.

clue.text: 6 — 0? Cancellation of service was a bloomer

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
the digit zero looks like the letter O
in tennis a let is a serve that is cancelled and replayed

explanation.surface: A tennis score of 6-0 and a replayed serve: someone blundered, a real howler.
explanation.walkthrough: A bloomer is a blunder in British slang, which fits the tennis scene; here it is literally a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A violet is a small flowering plant, so it is something that blooms.

clue.text: Prepare to shoot dog in Manhattan

parts.note: to cock a gun is to ready its hammer for firing
to tail someone is to dog or follow them

explanation.surface: A hunter readies a gun at a dog on the streets of New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Manhattan' looks like the New York borough setting the scene, but it is a whisky drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A Manhattan is a mixed drink of whiskey, vermouth and bitters, a classic example of the type.

clue.text: Not just a brunette

definitions.meaning: first meaning: not fair or equitable
second meaning, read whimsically: someone not fair-haired

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the word into un- plus fair, so a dark-haired person is literally not fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Unjust treatment is inequitable, and a brunette, being dark-haired, is jokingly not blonde.

clue.text: Start one off about parking

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around the next piece
off means the word one is spoiled and its letters jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, its three letters get jumbled

explanation.surface: Kick off one stretch of play by the car park.
explanation.definitionFit: To open something is to begin it, as one opens a meeting or a batting innings.

clue.text: Not available for office, having been involved in big lie about the Spanish

indicators.note: about means the tangled letters surround the next piece
involved means these letters have been tangled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, all eight letters are jumbled
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A candidate is barred from standing after being caught up in a big lie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' belongs to the anagram letters, not just the surface linking.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ineligible does not meet the conditions to be chosen or elected to a post.

clue.text: Go along with the gigolo

definitions.meaning: first meaning: accompany someone as a companion or guard

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests agreeing with a gigolo; the verb sense is literally accompanying someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To escort someone is to accompany them, and a hired escort is a paid companion such as a gigolo.

clue.text: In public, measure fat

indicators.note: In placed before the measure means it goes inside the word for public

parts.note: overt means open, done in public
to weigh is to measure heaviness

explanation.surface: Weigh yourself publicly to see how fat you are.
explanation.definitionFit: An overweight person is heavier than is healthy, so stout or plump.

clue.text: Pragmatic people are confused by series of names

indicators.note: confused means the letters of are are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written, its letters get mixed
lists are series of items such as names

explanation.surface: Practical types find themselves baffled by rolls of names.
explanation.definitionFit: Realists face things as they are and act on practical grounds rather than ideals.

clue.text: Supplementary material allows a cleric to finish article

parts.note: taken as written
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a cleric's degree
to end is to finish
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Extra pages permit a vicar to round off a piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Addenda are additions to a book or document, the plural of addendum.

clue.text: Expires, broken by a gamble and disease

indicators.note: broken by means the word for expires is split open with the next pieces inside

parts.note: dies means expires
taken as written
a bet is a gamble

explanation.surface: Someone dies, ruined by a wager and illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabetes is a chronic illness in which the body cannot control blood sugar.

clue.text: Group to conquer the French

parts.note: to beat is to defeat or conquer
les is the French plural for the

explanation.surface: A band sets out to defeat the French.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beatles were the Liverpool pop band of the 1960s, a famous example of a musical group.

clue.text: Show signs of anorexia? But I came up and had a meal

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the words I came are read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written, then read in reverse
ate is had a meal

explanation.surface: A patient insists they are not wasting away: they arrived and ate.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by example: wasting away is one sign of anorexia.
explanation.definitionFit: To emaciate is to become abnormally thin and wasted, a symptom typical of the eating disorder.

clue.text: Vague design cut into canopy overhead

indicators.note: into means the cut design goes inside the word for the canopy above

parts.note: the sky is the canopy above our heads
to etch is to cut a design into a surface

explanation.surface: A rough plan for a canopy is cut in above someone's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Sketchy information is incomplete and lacking detail, like a rough drawing.

clue.text: Disadvantage of retreat

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a snag or downside, as a noun
second meaning, read as two words

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the word into a phrasal verb, to draw back or withdraw.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawback is a snag or downside, and to draw back is to withdraw or pull away.

clue.text: Of the group, Den came up with Bill inside

indicators.note: inside means the bill goes within the other word
came up in a down clue means the word for den is read upwards

parts.note: an animal's den is its lair
AC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: Den arrived with a man named Bill among them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Den' and 'Bill' look like men's names; they are a lair and an account.
explanation.definitionFit: Racial means relating to a race, an ethnic group of people.

clue.text: Backpacking salesman reportedly on a bicycle?

indicators.note: reportedly means the word is heard rather than seen, so its sound gives the answer

parts.note: a pedaller is someone pedalling a bike

explanation.surface: A travelling salesman with a rucksack, said to go about by bike.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedlar is an itinerant hawker who carries goods from place to place to sell.

clue.text: Rising cry of approval involved in Parent-Teacher Association's grasp of the game

indicators.note: involved in means the reversed cry is put inside the next word

parts.note: PTA is the usual short form for a Parent-Teacher Association

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the cry is read upwards

parts.note: olé is the bullring shout of approval

explanation.surface: A cheer goes up as the school parents' group gets to grips with a sport.
explanation.walkthrough: Pelota is a Basque ball game played against a wall, like jai alai.
explanation.definitionFit: Pelota is a Basque court game in which a ball is struck against a wall with a basket or the hand.

clue.text: By chance confused client with a cad

indicators.note: confused means these letters are jumbled together

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone mixed up a customer with a scoundrel, quite unintentionally.
explanation.definitionFit: Something accidental happens by luck rather than design, as an unplanned event.

clue.text: I left to start work

indicators.note: start means the word to stands at the beginning, before the other pieces

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: I went off to begin my job.
explanation.definitionFit: To toil is to labour hard, a synonym for working.

clue.text: Calling me out causes a row

indicators.note: out means the letters of me are left out of the longer word

parts.note: a French-derived word for one's calling or vocation, also used in English
taken as written, these two letters are dropped

explanation.surface: Shouting me down sparks an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a row' suggests a quarrel, but it is a rank of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one of a series of rows or levels placed one above another, as in a stadium.

clue.text: Shrub found by Hamlet, perhaps, round the inn

indicators.note: round means the Dane goes around the inn

parts.note: Hamlet was the Prince of Denmark, so an example of a Dane
PH is public house, an inn

explanation.surface: A bush discovered by the Shakespearean prince near the tavern.
explanation.definitionFit: Daphne is a genus of fragrant flowering shrubs, used as a garden plant name.

clue.text: Successful show had other productions until now

parts.note: a hit is a successful show

indicators.note: productions are things made or staged, so these letters are produced anew in a different order

parts.note: taken as written, its letters get rearranged

explanation.surface: A hit show had other stagings up to the present.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto means up to this point in time, a formal synonym for so far.
